Wondrous Item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement by Its Creator)

A Philosopher’s Stone is a powerful alchemical reagent that only the alchemist who made it can use to good effect. While you carry it, you gain the following benefits.

Spellcasting Focus. You can use your Philosopher’s Stone as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells.

Transmute Resources. If you spend 1 hour (which can be part of a Short Rest) with your stone and crafting resources of a single kind (fish, gems, herbs, ores or stones, leather or hide, or cloth), you can magically turn them into resources of another kind with the same value. You could turn 100 GP worth of herbs into 100 GP worth of ore or the reverse, or 500 GP of mithril (a common ore) into 500 GP of truesilver (a rare ore).

Mixology. When you roll a die to determine the effect of a potion you drink (including the result of mixing potions), you can roll the die twice and choose either result. If a potion you drink has a duration, that duration is doubled.
